title: LLM isolation X3 follow-up: prove a plan-mode control capture, then drop the probe bypass grant
summary: X3 (#1127) moved every AllowBypass grant of a non-phase launch into bridge.launchPurposeConfig. The probe purpose (usage controller, /help and /model captures, RunRecipe) still gets AllowBypass, so its REPL boots with the bypass flag of the family. Spec llm-isolation.md §5.1 keeps the grant because the prompt markers and the auto-responder patterns of each manifest are proven only for the bypass boot. A plan-mode boot shows other dialogs, for example the plan approval of claude.
fix: Run one live control capture (/usage) per family (claude-tmux, agy-tmux, codex-tmux) with the probe purpose in plan mode or in the default permission mode. Add the auto-responder patterns that the boot needs to the manifests. Then make launchPurposeConfig grant AllowBypass to the smoke purpose only, and update spec §5.1.
acceptance: A live /usage capture in plan mode passes for each family with a usage control, with the pane transcript recorded in the PR
launchPurposeConfig grants AllowBypass to the smoke purpose only; TestLaunchPurposeConfig_GrantsBypassOnlyToTheProbeAndSmokePurposes is updated
Spec llm-isolation.md §5.1 no longer lists the probe bypass grant
source: console, 2026-10-26, independent review of PR #1127 (X3), item 2
